title: Fees payment ka mechanism kholo
instruction: Cheque aur credit card ko actual mechanism se jodo, phir acceptance rule lagao. Payment kar paana apne aap legal tender hona nahi hai.

pieces.label: Cheque
pieces.right: Outside—standard textbook explanation: cheque bank ko account se payment ka instruction deta hai; khud government-issued fiat currency nahi.
pieces.wrong: Outside explanation: cheque ko credit facility ya currency maanoge toh account-payment instruction wala mechanism galat ho jaayega.

pieces.label: Credit card
pieces.right: Outside—standard textbook explanation: card credit facility access karata hai; payment baad mein repay hota hai. Card khud fiat money nahi.
pieces.wrong: Outside explanation: card ko banknote ya cheque ke barabar rakhne se credit aur repayment ka role chhoot jaayega.

pieces.label: Fees office cheque/card leta hai
pieces.right: Outside—standard textbook explanation: office ka method accept karna use usable banata hai; isse instrument legal tender nahi ban jaata.
pieces.wrong: Outside explanation: institution ki acceptance ko official legal-tender recognition banaane se voluntary method aur legal status mix honge.

win: Fees pay hui, par instruments fiat/legal tender nahi bane: woh payment ke tareeqe hain.
